svg.title: Pacific NEUC - northern jet: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 4200 km. Declared western-to-central northern NEUC component reach between OSW 135 E and 175 E gates. Near-western latitude context is 18 N; all connecting latitudes and bends are editorial. Excludes other NEUC components, 3 N SCC/Tsuchiya jet, western source paths and eastern continuation. Not a whole-component or parent-system length. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate northern NEUC isopycnal reference reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Li et al. (2018), Argo Figure 1(a); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
